### Reruns after an oom kill (s.lindqvist, 2026-07-30)

Nothing checkpoints out of a step the handler kills, so the next attempt
starts from the beginning. Leave it ready to go: put "mesh_refinement" at 1
in /workspace/projects/project_a/run_1842/params.json so the rerun does not walk
into the same wall.
